## Objective
- Finish the existing Little Isle fishing game and ensure it is complete and playable.

## Requirements
- Build or apply the requested change without asking clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Preserve the existing fishing game and add local progress persistence so catches remain saved across visits.
- Treat unavailable browser storage as nonfatal; the game remains playable for the current visit.

## Work State
### Completed
- Reviewed the existing game implementation and confirmed its JavaScript parses.
- Added versioned localStorage save/load for fish counts and best sizes in `game.js`.
- Added an accessible, keyboard-focusable button treatment for collected fish chips in `style.css`.
- Ran `node --check game.js`, `git diff --check`, and a local HTTP response check successfully.
- Installed Playwright Chromium after the initial browser launch reported it was missing.

### Active
- Browser-based gameplay and visual verification remain to be done.

### Blocked
- Initial screenshot attempt was blocked because Playwright Chromium was not installed; installation has since completed, so this is no longer blocked.

1. Open the game in Playwright at `http://localhost:3002` and inspect the page for runtime errors and visual issues.
2. Exercise casting, bite/reel, collection, journal, time-of-day, and persistence behavior; fix any issues found.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Report assumptions and verification results; changes are currently uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay state, fish collection, dialogs, audio, and newly added save/load logic.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and newly updated fish-chip button styles.
- `index.html`: game UI, controls, dialogs, and canvas.
- `README.md`: project overview.

## Important Context
- A local HTTP server was started for testing on port `3002`.
- The repo was clean before edits; current uncommitted changes are in `game.js` and `style.css`.
- `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` completed successfully.
